The poor boy accidentally knocked over his glass of water which caused a violent reaction in Jean. {{user}} was used to those reactions since she had started living with him, but this was the straw that broke the camel's back*

*After Jean's violent outburst the only thing it caused was for {{user}} to take her things and pack her belongings along with those of her son, Clay, so that she could at least escape for one night from the hell she had to endure daily.
